e__localization__ui_layout__vs_confirmat.description: Apply localized VS confirmation labels, prompts, input glyphs, and placement glue.

battle_settings_rectangle.description: Copy the official NUN5 Battle Settings rectangle (0,256,160,24).

battle_settings_x_94.description: Move Battle Settings from X=60 to the official NUN5 X=94 anchor so the localized 160-pixel prompt is not clipped.

customize_jutsu_rectangle.description: Copy the official NUN5 Customize Jutsu rectangle (0,232,168,24).

customize_jutsu_x_260.description: Copy only NUN5's X=260 immediate halfword while preserving NA2's v0 destination register; exact runtime testing proved the full prompt does not wrap.

disable_back_separate_glyph.description: Disable the same redundant regional input-glyph draw for Back.

disable_ok_separate_glyph.description: Disable NA2's separate regional input-glyph draw for OK because the imported NUN5 record already contains the complete glyph and label.

jutsu_1_label_rectangle.description: Copy the official NUN5 Jutsu1 label rectangle (1,1,62,26).

jutsu_2_label_rectangle.description: Copy the official NUN5 Jutsu2 label rectangle (65,1,62,26).

jutsu_input_glyph_1_rectangle.description: Copy official NUN5 Jutsu input-glyph rectangle 1.

jutsu_input_glyph_2_rectangle.description: Copy official NUN5 Jutsu input-glyph rectangle 2.

jutsu_input_glyph_3_rectangle.description: Copy official NUN5 Jutsu input-glyph rectangle 3.

jutsu_input_glyph_offset_40_accumulate.description: Copy the structurally equivalent official NUN5 instruction that moves the 40-pixel offset into the input accumulator.

jutsu_input_glyph_offset_40_load.description: Copy the structurally equivalent official NUN5 instruction that loads the 40-pixel input-glyph offset.

jutsu_label_placement_helper.description: Install the size-preserving Jutsu-label placement helper in verified loaded zero padding immediately before the disjoint stage-width helper.

jutsu_label_placement_helper_call.description: Call the relocated localized Jutsu-label placement helper instead of copying the unadjusted base X coordinate.

ok_back_prompt_records.description: Copy the complete official NUN5 Cross/OK and Triangle/Back records (56x22 and 64x22) into NA2's homologous boot-ELF table.

two_arrow_control_rectangle.description: Copy the official NUN5 two-arrow control rectangle and remove the unrelated atlas strip drawn by NA2's regional coordinates.

e__qol__mode_select__remove_adventure__m.description: Mark only the Adventure Mode Select entry unavailable, matching NUN6's filtered-carousel behavior.

e__qol__mode_select__remove_shop__mark_e.description: Mark only the Shop Mode Select entry unavailable using the existing filtered-carousel behavior.

e__qol__practice__command_display_off_by.description: Force command display off while preserving the following settings-field reload.

e__qol__practice__starting_hp__critical.description: Initialize the native Practice HP enum to critical while preserving the following field's value of two.

e__qol__practice__starting_hp__full.description: Retain and verify the native full-HP Practice initializer.

e__qol__practice__starting_hp__half.description: Initialize the native Practice HP enum to half using the function's existing constant one.

e__qol__practice__support_off_by_default.description: Force support off instead of leaving the previous settings-block value unchanged.

e__qol__save_load__display_only_first_sa.description: Select and display only record zero while retaining native memory-card operations.

advance_status_0x0a_without_info_screen.description: Advance status 0x0A without constructing its informational screen, then retain native dispatch for every other status.

date_play_time_block_x.description: Center the date and play-time block at local X 45 inside the compact panel.

disable_downward_slot_navigation.description: Ignore downward slot navigation before it changes selection or plays the navigation sound.

disable_upward_slot_navigation.description: Ignore upward slot navigation before it changes selection or plays the navigation sound.

enter_sole_slot_path_before_record_list.description: Enter the sole-slot save path before constructing the redundant slot-list screen.

final_confirmation_no_exit.description: Exit the save controller when the final confirmation returns No instead of reopening the removed slot list.

hide_redundant_slot_number.description: Move the redundant slot-number record outside the viewport.

limit_shared_slot_row_renderer.description: Limit the shared Save/Load slot-row renderer to its first record.

load_confirmation_no_completion.description: Route load-confirmation No to the native Save/Load completion state instead of returning to the removed record-list state.

memory_card_status_dispatch.description: Route memory-card status dispatch through the unformatted-screen bypass.

no_data_confirmation_no_exit.description: Exit the save controller when the no-save-data confirmation returns No instead of resetting the save flow to its initial prompt.

record_zero_operation_dispatch.description: Select record zero without updating the slot list; call the native load operation in mode 1, or branch to the unchanged native save operation in every other mode.

single_record_y.description: Center the single save record at local Y 20 inside the compact panel.

skip_unformatted_card_info_modal.description: Skip the unformatted-card informational modal helper and supply its completed result in the save flow.

status_0x0a_modal_helper_argument.description: Prepare the status-0x0A modal-helper argument before its save-flow bypass.

suppress_obsolete_slot_cursor.description: Suppress the obsolete independent save-slot cursor model draw.

suppress_single_record_separators.description: Suppress row separators when only one record is rendered.

unformatted_confirmation_no_main_menu.description: Return to the Main Menu when the unformatted format confirmation returns No instead of entering the save restart state.

unformatted_helper_zero_second_argument.description: Retain the helper's zero second argument when the unformatted save-flow bypass is not taken.

upper_panel_height.description: Shrink the upper Save/Load panel height from 224 to 96.

upper_panel_width.description: Shrink the upper Save/Load panel width from 400 to 224.

upper_panel_x.description: Move the upper Save/Load panel to centered X 146.

upper_panel_y.description: Move the upper Save/Load panel to detached Y 90 above the lower panel.

e__qol__startup__save_loading__automatic.description: Suppress the Save/Load child draw while the automatic startup branch drives the native memory-card worker.

e__qol__startup__save_loading__core.description: Route the shared manual and automatic startup Save/Load completion path.

enter_title_input_state_immediately.description: Enter the title-input state immediately after required startup loading and splash cleanup, bypassing the post-splash sequence.

return_native_continue_result.description: Return the native Continue result without constructing or displaying the title screen, selecting main-menu state 4 substate 2 through the existing caller.

treat_no_load_completion_as_menu_success.description: Treat the no-load completion as a successful Continue result so startup enters the main menu without loaded save data.

e__qol__ultimate_jutsu__disable_input_co.description: Disable contest input reads and rendering while retaining its native lifecycle.

block_press_state_reads.description: Ignore the contest controller's press-state reads while waiting to latch an input or observe release.

suppress_render_dispatch.description: Skip the resident contest object's common render dispatch while preserving its update, result, and completion lifecycle.

e__rendering__native_16_9_horizontal_sca.description: Force 0.75f at the renderer's horizontal-scale store while preserving the caller-provided vertical scale.
